description: Returns the brand's pool of relevant subreddits — THIS IS the brand-level subreddit match (each scored). Use it to answer 'which/what/top N subreddits should my brand post in?' — NO content needed; results are sorted most-relevant first; pass `top` for a top-N list. (reddit_suggest is a different, content-specific step.) Reddit is a repurpose-to-Reddit workflow, NOT a scheduled publishing medium.

top.description: Return only the top N most-relevant subreddits (results are always sorted most-relevant first)

name: reddit_get_pool
